basePrompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE landscape 16:9 high-fidelity concept screenshot for German desktop postal strategy game "Ab die Post". The supplied image is the approved STYLE REFERENCE, not a screen to duplicate. Exactly preserve this art direction: warm ivory textured paper, subtle print grain, muted sage and sand geographic districts, golden postal-yellow buttons and postal pictograms, dark ink text, terracotta warnings, clear cobalt and teal routes with white edging, selected orange route, round route nodes, flat 2D map with blue river and bridges, small illustrated trees and roof silhouettes. Friendly bold slightly italic serif game logo "Ab die Post", readable humanist sans-serif UI. Consistent restrained rounded cream cards with fine ink outlines. No neon, no glass, no isometric/3D, no browser/device frame, no corporate dashboard styling. All user-facing text German with correct umlauts, very legible, limited and concise. Generous whitespace; functional game screenshot, not a marketing poster. Desktop composition. Shared in-game shell when relevant: compact top "Ab die Post" logo, "Budget 12.480 €", "Pünktlichkeit 94 %", "Zufriedenheit 87 %", pause and "1× 2× 4×", menu button; bottom navigation "Betrieb", "Gebiete", "Depots", "Flotte", "Touren", "Ausbau". This simulation delivers incoming mail to whole districts, no collection or returns, no individual houses as stops, no road construction. Shipment types: Werbung, Briefe, Einschreiben, Kleine Pakete, Speditionsware. Service class Standard or Express is separate from type. Vehicles: Fahrrad (no parcels or freight), Lastenrad (no freight), Lieferwagen (no freight), Lkw (all types). Numerical data are illustrative but internally consistent.

screens.title: Startmenü
screens.prompt: MAIN MENU without in-game HUD. Large beautiful "Ab die Post" postal logo at upper left and short subtitle "Dein Netz. Deine Touren. Deine Post." Elegant cream menu card left: dominant yellow "Fortsetzen" with small saved game line "Nordring · 6 Gebiete"; "Neue Partie"; "Spielstand importieren". Right two-thirds is beautiful decorative postal route map with envelope hub, bike, cargo bike, van and truck, same approved style. Modest footer "Spielstände werden lokal gespeichert". Small inset bottom-left shows alternate EMPTY SAVE state: "Noch keine Partie gespeichert", disabled Fortsetzen, active Neue Partie and Importieren. No accounts or online features.

Preview map on right with EXACTLY four districts Altstadt, Nordpark, Westend, Hafen around Postzentrum, connected roads, no required secondary depot. Start summary "4 Zustellgebiete", "Alle Sendungsarten verfügbar", "Geeignete Startflotte". Footer buttons "Zurück" and yellow "Starten". No difficulty settings, unlock cards, accounts or extra gameplay systems.

Warm paper coachmark pointing to postal center: "1 / 3 · Hier kommt die Post an", "Briefe und Werbung warten auf die nächste Tour." Two real data chips "Briefe 24" and "Werbung 60". Highlight one bike on cobalt route with small label "Fährt nach Altstadt". Coachmark buttons "Weiter" and "Hilfe ausblenden". Small hint near pause "In Ruhe planen: Pause". screens.title: Karte und Pause
screens.prompt: MAIN GAME MAP in manually PAUSED planning state. Six large districts Nordpark, Westend, Altstadt, Ostviertel, Südstadt, Hafen and two depots. screens.title: Betriebsübersicht
screens.prompt: OPERATIONS ANALYSIS screen, titled "Betriebsübersicht". Game shell. Main cream ledger/dashboard with hand-printed chart aesthetic, small map inset. Four clear headline cards "Offen 148", "Überfällig 12", "Pünktlichkeit 94 %", "Zufriedenheit 87 %". Large accounting section "Letzte 5 Simulationsminuten": "Erlöse 1.840 €", "Betriebskosten 1.220 €", "Operativer Saldo +620 €"; separate lower section "Investitionen 2.400 €" and "Sanierungszuschüsse 0 €" visually excluded from operating result. Simple labeled trend line. Side panel district satisfaction with five/six rows and explanation "Zustellungen und überfälliger Rückstand zählen". Link button "Probleme ansehen". Friendly paper ledger, not financial trading terminal.

screens.prompt: DISTRICT DETAIL / EDIT view. Map left half with selected Hafen in terracotta boundary and orange route. Right wide cream panel "Hafen". Stats "28 offen", "4 überfällig", "Zufriedenheit 78 %". Table with headers "Art", "Offen", "Überfällig": Werbung 6/0, Briefe 10/1, Einschreiben 4/1, Kleine Pakete 5/1, Speditionsware 3/1. Service-class chips Standard and Express shown separately, not attached to every registered letter. Below table dropdown "Zuständiges Depot" value "Depot Ost"; priority dropdown "Vorrang" value "Hoch"; labeled numeric field "Max. Bündelwartezeit" value "30 s". Notice "Gilt für neue Touren. Laufende Fahrten enden regulär." Buttons "Abbrechen", "Änderungen übernehmen".

Lower cards "Zuständige Gebiete: Hafen, Ostviertel", "Flotte: 1 Lastenrad · 2 Lieferwagen", action "Fahrzeug zuweisen". Clear buttons "Standort eröffnen" and secondary "Depot räumen". screens.title: Fahrzeug kaufen
screens.prompt: VEHICLE PURCHASE dialog over dimmed parchment fleet view. Wide cream catalog headed "Fahrzeug kaufen". Four aligned cards with charming dark ink yellow vehicle illustrations and exact headings Fahrrad, Lastenrad, Lieferwagen, Lkw. Distinguish price, capacity and operating cost with short illustrative values. Eligibility text explicit: Fahrrad "Werbung, Briefe, Einschreiben"; Lastenrad "Auch kleine Pakete"; Lieferwagen "Auch kleine Pakete"; Lkw "Alle Arten, auch Speditionsware". Select Lkw with yellow outline. Bottom "Zieldepot" dropdown "Depot Ost", clear total "Kaufpreis 4.800 €", "Budget danach 7.680 €", buttons "Abbrechen" and "Lkw kaufen". Only Lkw supports freight. No game locks, no random unlocks.

screens.title: Fahrt und Überführung
screens.prompt: VEHICLE TRIP detail screen. Game shell and map left, selected yellow van on orange numbered route Postzentrum → Altstadt → Hafen → Postzentrum. Right panel "Lieferwagen 03", phase tracker "Beladen — Fahren — Zustellen — Rückkehr" with Fahren active. "Ziel: Altstadt", shipment list "Briefe 12 · Express", "Kleine Pakete 6 · Standard", load "18 / 30 LE". Below, open clearly separated relocation preview card "Nach Depot West verlegen", "Überführung nach Rückkehr, ohne Ladung", "Fahrtkosten 18 €", button "Verlegung vormerken". screens.title: Toureneditor
screens.prompt: TOUR TEMPLATE EDITOR with game shell. Left half geographic map with clear numbered highlighted route 1 Altstadt, 2 Nordpark, 3 Westend, start and end at Postzentrum. Right cream editor "Tourvorlage bearbeiten", name field "Nordrunde", type selector "Lastenrad", assigned vehicle "Lastenrad 02". Ordered stop list with each row having visible up/down arrow buttons and remove ×, plus "Gebiet hinzufügen". "Geschätzte Fahrzeit 4:20", "Max. Bündelwartezeit 30 s". Note "Verbindlich für zugewiesene Fahrzeuge" and "Laufende Tour bleibt unverändert". Bottom primary "Vorlage speichern", secondary "Automatik übernehmen lassen". Small text status "Vorschau gültig". No freehand road construction or drag-only editing.

screens.title: Problemdiagnose
screens.prompt: PROBLEM DIAGNOSIS screen. Game shell, clear map on left with THREE numbered warning locations; right 55% a cream panel "Probleme" with three focused actionable stacked cards. Card1 Hafen: "Kein Lkw für Speditionsware", "3 Sendungen warten", action "Flotte zuweisen". Card2 Depot Ost: "Ladeplätze ausgelastet", "2 Fahrzeuge warten", action "Depot ansehen". Card3 Nordrunde: "Vorlage bindet geeignete Fahrzeuge", action "Tourvorlage öffnen". Severity uses icons and text, not only colors. Bottom quiet status "Keine Sendung geht verloren". Focus on concrete cause → affected location → action. Terracotta warnings warm, no aggressive catastrophic alarm. Add two compact secondary diagnostic rows "Depot West: Lager voll" and "Gesamtkapazität zu gering", each with a labeled action.

Preview panel "Zusätzliches Aufkommen", "Benötigte Kapazität", "Empfehlung: 1 Lieferwagen". Buttons "Später" and "Auf 6 Gebiete erweitern". Bottom small separate example state card labeled "Nach Ziel 3" with "Alle Ausbauziele erreicht", "Frei weiterspielen". Never automatic expansion or random unlock rewards.

screens.title: Krise und Wiederanlauf
screens.prompt: Create a deliberate TWO-PANEL concept comparison sheet of the same game map before and after recovery, in approved warm paper art style, each panel with clearly readable compact game HUD. Title "Ab die Post · Sanierung und Wiederanlauf". Left titled "Krise": Budget −1.200 €, Pünktlichkeit 61 %, Zufriedenheit 48 %, Hafen badge "38 überfällig", "Kein geeigneter Lkw", prominent button "Sanierung planen". Right titled "Wiederanlauf": Budget 0 €, SAME Pünktlichkeit 61 % and SAME Zufriedenheit 48 % (must not reset), Postzentrum card "Bergungsbestand: 38 Sendungen", Lkw now available, "Zuschuss: 6.000 € · kein Erlös", "Bewertungsfenster: 0:00 / 5:00", notice "Sendungsalter bleibt erhalten". Show button "Betrieb fortsetzen". Below right a small visible manual pause badge "Manuelle Pause bleibt aktiv". Clearly same geography, improved vehicle suitability, not magically completed deliveries or cleared backlog.
